entry.summary: 《未来链上治理 Futarchy 的现状》（作者：Zack Pokorny）本文探讨了 Futarchy（未来治理）在 DAOs 治理中的应用现状及其链上预测市场的发展。Futarchy 是一种通过预测市场指导决策的治理模式，它将目标设定与实现目标的方法分离，利用金融市场的预测能力和参与者的真实货币投入，激励更准确的预测和严格分析。文章还分析了 Polymarket 和 MetaDAO 等平台在 Futarchy 实践中的表现，以及 Futarchy 在 Solana 和以太坊生态系统中的扩展和应用。Polymarket 的预测市场在美国大选后使用量有所下降，但仍高于选举前水平，显示出持续的市场活跃度。Solana 的 MetaDAO 是 Futarchy 治理的首次大规模实施，自 2023 年 11 月推出以来已为 9 个 DAOs 提供了 62 次 Futarchy 服务。Optimism 和 Uniswap 基金会宣布联合探索治理中的预测市场应用等。https://www.wublock123.com/index.php?m=content&c=index&a=show&catid=6&id=39905

She also exposed a16z leaking AWS keys, database credentials, and PII—sitting in inspect element. That hack could’ve compromised one of the biggest VCs in crypto. Her reward? $0. Then, she discovered a way to hijack someone’s Arc browser without them even visiting a website — letting attackers execute arbitrary JavaScript on any page. That time, she got $2K. $57K total for stopping multiple disasters. Some people break crypto. Xyzeva keeps saving it.

RT arctotherium Immigration and fertility are the two things I most write about, so this article was probably inevitable. The thrust of it: "we need immigration because of low birth rates" is not only wrong but actively counterproductive; immigration makes the problems of population decline worse, not better. It barely budges population aging, lowers living standards, makes paying pensions harder, not easier, weakens national unity and thus national strength, and erases ethnic groups rather than ensure their continuance. Read it below.
Noah Carl: "Once you start looking at the reasons why a growing population might be beneficial, it becomes clear that actually-existing immigration makes the problems of population decline worse, not better." https://www.aporiamagazine.com/p/immigration-does-not-solve-population
